description: 同一技能 csv_row_cleaning 的递增难度序列：从解析 CSV，到缺失值处理、类型转换、去重，最终组合成完整清洗流水线。

tasks.description: Write a Python function named `parse_csv_rows` that takes a string `text` (first line = comma-separated header, following lines = comma-separated values) and returns a list of dicts mapping header name to raw string value. Do not import anything except the standard library string methods (no `csv` module).

Write a Python function named `drop_missing` that takes `rows` (list of dicts) and `required_fields` (list of str). Return a new list keeping only rows where every field in `required_fields` has a non-empty string value. If `required_fields` is empty, keep all rows.

test_cases.description: 过滤缺失 name 或 age 的行
无必填字段时全部保留

tasks.description: Write a Python function named `normalize_types` that takes `rows` (list of dicts) and `numeric_fields` (list of str). For each row, convert every field listed in `numeric_fields` from string to float. If a field is missing or cannot be converted to float, drop that entire row from the output. Return the resulting list of dicts (non-numeric fields unchanged).

Write a Python function named `dedupe_rows` that takes `rows` (list of dicts) and `key_fields` (list of str). Return a new list keeping only the first occurrence of each unique combination of values at `key_fields`, preserving original order.

test_cases.description: 去掉完全重复的第二行

tasks.description: Write a Python function named `clean_pipeline` that takes `text` (raw CSV string), `required_fields` (list of str), `numeric_fields` (list of str), and `key_fields` (list of str). Combine parsing, dropping rows with missing required fields, converting numeric fields to float (dropping rows that fail conversion), and de-duplicating by `key_fields` (keep first). Return the final cleaned list of dicts. This combines all the skills from the previous tasks in this family into one pipeline.

test_cases.description: 完整流水线：丢缺失、转数值、去重
第二行数值转换失败被丢弃
